criteria.requirement: Add yaml.limits.LimitedSafeLoader/load_limited for decoded str single-document input only. Optional strict nonnegative integer max_chars, max_nodes (nonalias nodes), max_depth (root=1, keys count), max_aliases (reference occurrences). Check text length before parse and node/depth/alias budgets before compose; marked ComposerError for node constraints, YAMLError for text budget. Preserve normal safe graph identity and finally dispose, empty document zero budgets legal. No byte/stream budget claim, no large exhaustion payloads, no changes to default loader limits.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
